a row fitting wrapped text was its lines' pixels rounded together (28.5 for two lines of Calibri 11, 69 for five), where Excel 16 gives a multiple of one line's row (measured: 29, 43.5, 58, 72.5 at 14.5 a line)

General numbers in a narrow column showed #### where Excel shows them shorter: 1234567890 is 1E+09 in a column 5 wide, 99999 fits in 5, 12345.678 is 12346 (measured); whole numbers never went scientific and the digit's fractional width took a character away. The #### fills one # a character
test: unit:General: a whole number too wide for its column is shown in scientific notation, as Excel's

summary: a rule added by FormatConditions.Add(..., "=10") kept the = in its formula: the Rules Manager listed greater than =10 and Edit Rule showed ==10 (OK there would have stored a second =); Python's rules are kept without it, as the dialogs keep theirs

Insert Function's search listed its matches alphabetically: in the Chinese UI, where a word matches only the descriptions, the word for average chose AVEDEV and the one for adding up DSUM; matches are ranked now (name, name prefix, the common functions, short descriptions)
A validation's input message was drawn before the validation circles, tables and objects, so the circle around the cell below crossed it; it is drawn last now
Holding Ctrl and then dragging a sheet tab (Excel's way to copy a sheet) did nothing: a drag started only on a press without Ctrl
Renaming a sheet to a name in use said 'A sheet with that name already exists.' where Excel 16 says 'That name is already taken. Try a different one.' (measured)
Find All's list left the row clicked unhighlighted, and its rows were listed in ui.items only by their sheet's name (also a tab's)
Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+Tab, Ctrl+PgDn and Ctrl+PgUp did nothing in a tabbed dialog (Format Cells, Find and Replace, Page Setup...), where Excel moves between its tabs
Menus opened over the cells (filter, Paste Options, Auto Fill Options, error checking, Quick Analysis, a PivotTable field filter, a slicer menu) took the zoomed cells font and grew with the zoom
(Select All) in the AutoFilter list, a PivotTable field filter and Chart Filters read empty while some values were ticked, where Excel shows a mixed box
A hidden instance said nowhere what a click on a web link would have opened, so no test could tell a followed link from an ignored one: ui.state() reports desktop_open and desktop_opens

Most combo boxes (Data Validation Allow, Format Cells lists) were nameless in ui.items, as ImGui reports no label for them, and every range box was one ##rb: combo boxes go through a naming wrapper (check_lessons combo-name), range boxes are also listed by key

Dialogs take none of Excel's access keys (Alt + the underlined letter, or the letter alone off a text box: Alt+C for Comma in Text to Columns); only Paste Special has its letters. About 850 check boxes, option buttons and buttons, each needing the letter Excel gives it. Insert, Delete, Text to Columns, Go To (Alt+S), Go To Special and Find and Replace have theirs now (DlgKey: Ctrl+- R Enter, F5 Alt+S K Enter, Ctrl+H Tab Alt+A); no dialog lets Alt reach the ribbon any more (NoteDialogKeyboard), but most options still have no letter; the rest is a feature to decide (build, or Not planned)

Tab from a table last column left the table (Excel wraps to the next row, and its last cell adds a row); Tab ending an entry on a protected sheet went to the locked cell beside it. One function now for both Tab paths

Flash Fill from one example took a word counted from the start (2330 as the third word of Taiwan Semi (2330)) and filled nothing for MediaTek (2454); Excel 16 takes the word at either end (measured with Range.FlashFill)
chaos counted 21 protected-sheet refusals as problems: since 2026-11-25 they go to the Error Log as errors (no message box); entries are marked refusal now and chaos expects them

F5, Alt+S, K, Enter (select the blanks) chose nothing, so the = Up Ctrl+Enter after it wrote a formula into every cell of the range, data included; Go To Special and the Go To Special button take Excel letters now

Alt+A in Find and Replace (Replace All) went to the ribbon KeyTips behind the dialog, which is not modal, and replaced nothing; the ribbon leaves Alt to a dialog with the keyboard and the dialog takes Excel letters

Greater Than, Less Than and Equal To proposed the selection's average and Between its lowest and highest; Excel 16 proposes halfway between the lowest and highest, and for Between a quarter and three quarters of the way rounded (measured: 3..88 gives 45.5, 24 and 67)
Text That Contains opened empty; Excel 16 starts it with the active cell's text (measured: MSFT with B3 active), so highlighting a ticker took typing it

Cancelling the Sort dialog (Cancel, Escape, the close box) left the whole list selected, the cells it had shown behind the dialog; Excel 16 puts back the cell selected before (measured), so the next key or format acted on the list

Series from one cell with a Stop value filled nothing: the series ran only over the selection, where Excel 16 goes on to the Stop value (measured: 1 in A1, step 3, stop 10 fills A1:A4), the usual way to number a column; a series that never reaches its Stop value fills nothing, as in Excel

Every ribbon drop-down opened where the mouse was, so Alt, H, N showed the Number Format list in the screen's corner; the arrows did nothing in a ribbon drop-down and the Enter that picked an entry also moved the active cell down; drop-downs open under their button and take the arrows and Enter as in Excel
